description: Should we trust this vendor? One-call vendor safety check for a domain. $0.04 USDC on Base per call. Combines TLS certificate, DNS/DMARC, email-security score, ransomware leak-site claims (claims, not confirmed) and live outage status into a safe/caution/risk/incomplete verdict with reasons. Charged only if at least one check returns real data. Don't use this as proof of a breach. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: vendorsafety_vendor_safety
title: Vendor Safety Check: GET /v1/vendor-safety
